parts.name: beam body

physics.Basic_description: Long, flat silver metallic bar forming the main backbone of the tool with a matte finish.
physics.Functional_description: Provides the rigid reference length and guide rail for the sliding jaw mechanism.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the flat side or top edge of the beam firmly to stabilize the tool during use.
physics.reason: Caliper beams are typically solid machined or stamped steel bars to ensure rigidity and measurement accuracy.

parts.description: Long, flat silver metallic bar forming the main backbone of the tool with a matte finish.
parts.function: Provides the rigid reference length and guide rail for the sliding jaw mechanism.

parts.name: beam scale

physics.Basic_description: Dark linear markings etched along the top surface of the silver beam.
physics.Functional_description: Provides the primary linear measurement graduations in inches or millimeters.
physics.Grasped_description: Not intended for grasping; avoid obscuring the scale with fingers.
physics.reason: The scale is an etched or printed surface feature on the solid beam material.

parts.description: Dark linear markings etched along the top surface of the silver beam.
parts.function: Provides the primary linear measurement graduations in inches or millimeters.

parts.name: fixed jaw

physics.Basic_description: L-shaped silver metal component at the left end of the beam with precision ground faces.
physics.Functional_description: Acts as the stationary reference point against which the object is measured.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the upper shank or the outer face to hold the caliper steady.
physics.reason: Jaws must be solid metal to resist deflection under measuring force.

parts.description: L-shaped silver metal component at the left end of the beam with precision ground faces.
parts.function: Acts as the stationary reference point against which the object is measured.

parts.name: slider body

physics.Basic_description: Movable silver metal housing that wraps around the beam and holds the dial mechanism.
physics.Functional_description: Slides along the beam to adjust the jaw opening and carries the dial indicator.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the sides or top of the slider body to move the jaws open or closed.
physics.reason: The slider is a cast or machined housing with an internal cavity for the rack gear and dial mechanism, not a solid block.

parts.description: Movable silver metal housing that wraps around the beam and holds the dial mechanism.
parts.function: Slides along the beam to adjust the jaw opening and carries the dial indicator.

parts.name: dial bezel

physics.Basic_description: Circular silver ring surrounding the dial face with a smooth metallic finish.
physics.Functional_description: Secures the dial glass and allows for zero-setting adjustment by rotation.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the rim gently to rotate the bezel for calibration.
physics.reason: Bezels are thin rings or shells designed to hold the glass, not solid cylinders.

parts.description: Circular silver ring surrounding the dial face with a smooth metallic finish.
parts.function: Secures the dial glass and allows for zero-setting adjustment by rotation.

parts.name: dial face

physics.Basic_description: White circular disc visible through the clear cover, featuring black numerals and ticks.
physics.Functional_description: Displays the fine measurement reading via the rotating needle.
physics.Grasped_description: Do not grasp; pressing on the glass may damage the mechanism or obscure the reading.
physics.reason: Modeled as the glass cover or the solid backing plate of the dial assembly.

parts.description: White circular disc visible through the clear cover, featuring black numerals and ticks.
parts.function: Displays the fine measurement reading via the rotating needle.

parts.name: dial ticks

physics.Basic_description: Fine black graduation marks printed on the white dial face.
physics.Functional_description: Indicates precise fractional units of measurement.
physics.reason: Surface print/ink layer with negligible thickness, treated as part of the solid face.

parts.description: Fine black graduation marks printed on the white dial face.
parts.function: Indicates precise fractional units of measurement.

parts.name: thumb roller

physics.Basic_description: Small cylindrical wheel with a textured edge located below the dial on the slider.
physics.Functional_description: Allows the user to finely adjust the jaw position using their thumb.
physics.Grasped_description: Roll between the thumb and finger to slide the jaws smoothly.
physics.reason: Small functional component typically machined from solid stock for durability.

parts.description: Small cylindrical wheel with a textured edge located below the dial on the slider.
parts.function: Allows the user to finely adjust the jaw position using their thumb.

parts.name: depth rod

physics.Basic_description: Thin, flat silver metal strip extending from the right end of the beam.
physics.Functional_description: Measures the depth of holes or steps by extending as the jaws open.
physics.Grasped_description: Too thin and flexible to grasp effectively; avoid bending.
physics.reason: Depth rods are thin solid strips of spring steel.

parts.description: Thin, flat silver metal strip extending from the right end of the beam.
parts.function: Measures the depth of holes or steps by extending as the jaws open.

parts.name: needle

physics.Basic_description: Very thin black pointer centered on the dial face.
physics.Functional_description: Rotates to indicate the precise measurement value on the dial scale.
physics.Grasped_description: Extremely fragile; never attempt to grasp.
physics.reason: Needles are thin solid wires or stamped metal pieces.

parts.description: Very thin black pointer centered on the dial face.
parts.function: Rotates to indicate the precise measurement value on the dial scale.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained

simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)
